in_sanskrit.name: सुसन्तो
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सुसु (su-su) meaning good or auspicious and अन्तो (anto) meaning end or limit. Hence, Susanto means 'having good or auspicious qualities up to the end or limit'. It is also interpreted as 'having good or auspicious qualities in all aspects'.

in_hindi.name: सुसन्तो
in_hindi.long_meaning: शुभ (shubh) meaning good or auspicious and गुण (gun) meaning qualities. Hence, Susanto in Hindi means 'having good or auspicious qualities'.

in_tamil.name: சுசந்தோ
in_tamil.long_meaning: சுசு (cucu) meaning good or auspicious and ந்தோ (ndho) meaning end or limit. Hence, Susanto in Tamil means 'having no bad qualities up to the end'.

in_telugu.name: శుశంటో
in_telugu.long_meaning: శుశీ (shushi) meaning good or auspicious and కర్యపూర్ణ (kar-yapurnam) meaning work or action. Hence, Susanto in Telugu means 'having good or auspicious qualities in work or actions'.

in_marathi.name: Susanto
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blessed with good fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Susanto हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has abundance, prosperity and is blessed with good fortune

in_bengali.name: Susanto
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Blessed with good fortune
in_bengali.long_meaning: Susanto একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has abundance, prosperity and is blessed with good fortune

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu culture, the name Susanto holds deep significance as it is believed that the person bearing this name is favored by the gods and is blessed with material wealth and prosperity. Susanto is a name that signifies opulence and abundance. The name resonates with the abundance of nature and the richness of life.

It signifies the abundance of love, peace, and joy that comes from within and is not dependent on external circumstances. Susanto is a reminder of the divine wealth that lies within each of us, waiting to be unlocked and experienced. It is a name that inspires us to be grateful for the blessings we have and to keep our hearts open to receive more. It is a name that embodies the essence of the abundant and loving presence of the divine.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Susanto is a name of a king mentioned in the Mahabharata, the great Indian epic. The name Susanto carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Susanto continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
